ideas.topic: The Secret Engineering Behind the Great Pyramid
ideas.hook: Modern engineers are still baffled by how the pyramids were aligned to true north with near-perfect precision 4,500 years ago.
ideas.why: It taps into the 'how did they do it?' curiosity gap that consistently drives engagement on educational Ancient Egypt content.
